about_the_game:
Jungle Shadow is a Action-Adventure 2D Game where you play as a sneaky, but fast warrior that can be ruthless at times as she self-trained living and breathing with her shiny blade, mystical red-violet and maroon hair and clothes in the gigantic Jungle. You are in for a long adventure of watching in front of you threatening animals, crazy lengths of survival like you will have to hang on swampy vines and hiding behind the tall plants to avoid getting caught at times that will lead to massive danger. You are in the world's most dangerous Jungle as scientists and the world try to uncover what the Jungle is exactly, how long it existed and what is inside of it.

GAME FEATURES:

Slashly and Punchy Combat: You swift through and use the environment to your advantage to slay your enemy with your sharp blade. It picked a fight to you and failing won't be a viable option to your journey in Platoshira. You'll notice an enemy ahead too. Additionally, you will sometimes automatically activate finishers on enemies to make sure they won't see a shine of daylight and sometimes you'll just leave them as you think their dead, but others might come back for more later on when you return to that location. 

Knife Throwing: This will be a skill later on in the game where as you progress throughout the game and basically level up, train yourself. You'll be able to throw knifes at far lengths and it is a really effective skill to gain more advantage against the enemies and stagger them before they get to you. 

Smooth and Swifty Movement: The speed and jump power will vary and you'll have to move around a lot especially when your encountering and fighting an enemy. Playing on controller for Jungle Shadow feels good too if you would want to give that a try.

Vine Movement: In some cases, you'll have to use vines to progress through the land of Platoshira with water or traps underneath, so you'll have to avoid that entirely otherwise you will be accepting easy defeat immediately. 

XP & Levelling Up: This can make your character more stronger in the land of Platoshira by cutting up certain plants that drop glinting orbs with different colours equating to different amounts of XP. You can also later on unlock a few areas that are locked in different levels and realistically, it will be a bunch of rocks that you have to be strong enough to break them forcefully.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 or AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750, 1GB or AMD Radeon RX 460
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050, 1GB or AMD RTX 570
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Jungle Shadow is a Action-Adventure in the world's most dangerous Jungle. Platoshira. You play as a mystical warrior exploring through the bushes and trunky trees in red-violet clothes in the sense of mystery. The Jungle is a mystery. Scientists with their advanced tech slowly uncovers the Jungle.
